mechanism: SGLT2 inhibitors like dapagliflozin increase urinary potassium excretion and reduce aldosterone secretion, leading to hyperkalemia risk, especially in patients with renal impairment or concurrent ACE inhibitors/ARBs.
action: Monitor serum potassium levels regularly; assess renal function; consider potassium supplementation cautiously and only if clinically indicated with frequent monitoring; avoid concurrent use of potassium-elevating agents when possible.
